previewText: A simple summer home check, one useful market thought, and a local Suwanee event.

paragraphs: I hope you had a safe and enjoyable Fourth of July weekend.
Summer has a way of moving quickly. Between vacations, family plans, yard work, and trying to stay cool, the weeks can get away from us.
So this week's note is simple: one helpful thought about today's real estate market, one quick home-maintenance check, and a local event you may want to enjoy with the family.
As always, if a real estate question comes up, I'm here to help you sort through it - step by step.

market.title: More choices can slow decisions a little
paragraphs: In May 2026, Realtor.com showed that Gwinnett buyers had more active listings to choose from than a year earlier.
When buyers have more options, homes can take a little longer to stand out unless the price, condition, and first impression all work together.
That does not mean the market is weak. It means presentation and strategy matter even more when shoppers can compare several homes in the same price range.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data for May 2026, released June 3, 2026.

homeownerTip.title: Give your cooling system a quick summer check.
homeownerTip.intro: A few minutes this week can help your home stay more comfortable during the hottest stretch of summer:
items: Change or inspect the HVAC filter if it looks dusty.
Clear leaves, grass, and debris away from the outdoor condenser unit.
Make sure supply vents inside the house are open and not blocked by furniture.
If one room always feels warmer than the rest, make a note before a service call so the technician can check airflow.
homeownerTip.closing: Small checks now can make it easier to catch a comfort problem before it turns into a mid-summer repair surprise.

localEvent.title: Suwanee Town Center Summer Walk
localEvent.intro: If you want a simple nearby outing this week, Suwanee is still a good option.
localEvent.copy: Town Center Park and the nearby walkable area make an easy family stop for an evening stroll, coffee, or a casual bite after the heat starts to fade.
localEvent.tip: Tip: Check the City of Suwanee website before you go for any current event, parking, or weather updates.

cartoon.imageAlt: A homeowner proudly pointing at a freshly changed air filter while the family enjoys cool air indoors
cartoon.caption: "I changed one filter and suddenly I feel like the chief engineer of summer."
cartoon.closing: Sometimes the smallest house jobs create the biggest sense of victory.
